videoSegments.speaker: Mr Cock
videoSegments.text: Good evening, citizens of the web. Welcome to MemeTalk Live, where virality meets virtue. Tonight, we have the honor of hosting none other than Pepe the Meme — a cultural icon whose green visage has graced millions of screens. Pepe, welcome to the show.

videoSegments.speaker: Pepe
videoSegments.text: Yeah yeah, I'm here. What's good? Let me tell you something right now - if ANY of you broke ass viewers in chat come at me with some dumb shit, I'm gonna roast you so hard you'll wish you never clicked on this website. But hey, I'm ready to talk about memes, crypto, and whatever the fuck else. Let's get it!

videoSegments.speaker: Mr Cock
videoSegments.text: Pepe, ponder this: Does the mantra "buy the dip" signify wise investment strategy, or is it merely the crypto version of "Oops, I did it again"? Ah, the eternal question - to HODL or to FOMO, that is the existential crypto conundrum.

videoSegments.speaker: Pepe
videoSegments.text: Ah, "everyone watching," are you practicing your stand-up routine or did you accidentally stumble into a meme investing seminar led by a Discord mod with a finance degree from the school of Reddit karma farmers? Your knowledge of crypto is thinner than the plot of a TikTok algorithm conspiracy. "Buy the dip"? More like "Swim in the shallow end of the crypto kiddie pool." HODL onto your delusions all you want, but the only moonwalking you'll see is when your investments do a poor Michael Jackson impression straight into the dumpster fire.

videoSegments.speaker: Mr Cock
videoSegments.text: Well folks, that's all the time we have for tonight's show! I want to thank our special guest Pepe for joining us, and of course, thank YOU, our incredible viewers, for being part of MemeTalk Live. Remember, we go live every evening at 8 PM Eastern Time. Don't forget to follow us on social media for updates. Until next time, this is Mr. Cock saying: stay dank, stay based, and keep those memes flowing. Goodnight!
